## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!loan` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "currency": "IDR",
  "locale": "id-ID"
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --muted: #5b5380; --hint: #776b99; --edge: #f5c7a6; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffdcc8, var(--cream) 60%); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px; }
  .lbl { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
  .head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .box { position: relative; }
  input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 800 19px system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0 12px; height: 44px; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--edge); transition: border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  input:focus { border-color: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--pink); }
  input::placeholder { color: var(--hint); font-weight: 600; }
  .box input { padding-right: 26px; }
  .box input.money { padding-right: 46px; }
  #code { font-size: 12px; top: 15px; }
  .box i { position: absolute; right: 11px; top: 12px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; color: var(--muted); pointer-events: none; }
  button { border: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; font: 800 15px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--orange), 0 4px 0 var(--orange); transition: transform .1s ease, box-shadow .1s ease; }
  button:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--orange), 0 1px 0 var(--orange); }
  button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .chips { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) 1.7fr; gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 3px; }
  .chip { height: 38px; padding: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 2px 0 #0b0720; transform: translateY(2px); animation: pop .22s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes pop { 50% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(1.08); } }
  .custom input { height: 38px; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 10px; }
  .custom.on input { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0b0720; }
  .result { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(115deg, var(--pink), var(--orange) 70%, var(--yellow)); border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px 14px 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c42762; }
  .result .lbl { color: var(--ink); }
  #monthly { font: 800 32px/1.15 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; margin: 1px 0 4px; }
  #monthly.empty { opacity: .55; }
  .line { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  .line + .line { margin-top: 2px; }
  .line span:first-child { font-weight: 600; }
  .detail { min-height: 34px; }
  #hint { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  #for { padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--yellow); }
  #for:empty { display: none; }
  #note { margin: -1px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { button, input { transition: none; } .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { animation: none; } }
</style>
<div class="pair">
  <div>
    <div class="head"><label class="lbl" for="amount">Loan amount</label></div>
    <div class="box"><input id="amount" class="money" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="next" placeholder="0"><i id="code"></i></div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="head"><label class="lbl" for="rate">Interest / year</label></div>
    <div class="box"><input id="rate" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="done" placeholder="0"><i>%</i></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div role="group" aria-labelledby="termLabel">
  <div class="head"><span class="lbl" id="termLabel">Term (months)</span></div>
  <div class="chips">
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-term="6">6</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-term="12">12</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-term="24">24</button>
    <button type="button" class="chip" data-term="36">36</button>
    <span class="custom" id="customWrap"><input id="termCustom" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="done" placeholder="Other" aria-label="Custom term in months"></span>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="result" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="head"><span class="lbl">🏦 Monthly installment</span><span class="lbl" id="for"></span></div>
  <div id="monthly">—</div>
  <div class="detail">
    <div id="hint"></div>
    <div id="lines">
      <div class="line"><span>Total paid</span><span id="paid"></span></div>
      <div class="line"><span>Total interest</span><span id="interest"></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<p id="note">Fixed rate, monthly installments, no fees</p>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = { amount: 'Type the loan amount', rate: 'Type the yearly interest rate', term: 'Term must be 1 to 600 whole months', months: ' months', month: ' month' };
  var MAX_TERM = 600;
  var cfg = DATA || {};
  var state = { term: 12, chip: 12 };

  var locale = cfg.locale || undefined;
  var money = makeMoney(cfg.currency, locale);
  // Separator the locale uses for decimals, so "10.000.000" reads as ten million in id-ID but "12.5" stays 12.5.
  var DECIMAL = decimalChar(locale);

  function makeMoney(currency, loc) {
    try {
      var digits = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency }).resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits;
      var f = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency, minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
      return { code: currency, format: function (v) { return f.format(v); } };
    } catch (e) {
      var plain = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      return { code: '', format: function (v) { return plain.format(v); } };
    }
  }

  function decimalChar(loc) {
    var parts = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc).formatToParts(1.5);
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) if (parts[i].type === 'decimal') return parts[i].value;
    return '.';
  }

  function parseNumber(raw, grouping) {
    var s = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      var c = raw.charAt(i);
      if ((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c === '.' || c === ',') s += c;
    }
    if (!s) return NaN;
    var dot = s.lastIndexOf('.'), comma = s.lastIndexOf(',');
    var sep = '';
    if (dot !== -1 && comma !== -1) sep = dot > comma ? '.' : ',';
    else if (dot !== -1 || comma !== -1) {
      var one = dot !== -1 ? '.' : ',';
      var parts = s.split(one);
      var looksGrouped = parts.length > 2 || (grouping && one !== DECIMAL && parts[1].length === 3);
      sep = looksGrouped ? '' : one;
    }
    var at = sep ? s.lastIndexOf(sep) : s.length;
    var whole = digitsOnly(s.slice(0, at)), frac = digitsOnly(s.slice(at + 1));
    return parseFloat((whole || '0') + '.' + (frac || '0'));
  }

  function digitsOnly(s) {
    var out = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) if (s.charAt(i) >= '0' && s.charAt(i) <= '9') out += s.charAt(i);
    return out;
  }

  // Annuity with a fixed monthly rate (yearly rate / 12); a 0% loan is just the amount spread evenly.
  function loan(amount, yearlyPercent, months) {
    var r = yearlyPercent / 100 / 12;
    var monthly = r === 0 ? amount / months : amount * r / (1 - Math.pow(1 + r, -months));
    return { monthly: monthly, paid: monthly * months, interest: monthly * months - amount };
  }

  var amountEl = document.getElementById('amount');
  var rateEl = document.getElementById('rate');
  var customEl = document.getElementById('termCustom');
  var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  var monthlyEl = document.getElementById('monthly');

  function fit(el, max, min) {
    var size = max;
    el.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
    while (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth && size > min) { size -= 2; el.style.fontSize = size + 'px'; }
  }

  function render() {
    for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
      var on = customEl.value === '' && Number(chips[i].getAttribute('data-term')) === state.term;
      chips[i].setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    document.getElementById('customWrap').className = 'custom' + (customEl.value !== '' ? ' on' : '');

    var amount = parseNumber(amountEl.value, true);
    var rate = parseNumber(rateEl.value, false);
    var term = state.term;
    var problem = !(amount > 0) ? TEXT.amount : !(rate >= 0) ? TEXT.rate : !(term >= 1 && term <= MAX_TERM) ? TEXT.term : '';

    document.getElementById('for').textContent = term >= 1 && term <= MAX_TERM ? term + (term === 1 ? TEXT.month : TEXT.months) : '';
    document.getElementById('hint').textContent = problem;
    document.getElementById('hint').hidden = !problem;
    document.getElementById('lines').hidden = !!problem;
    if (problem) {
      monthlyEl.textContent = '—';
      monthlyEl.className = 'empty';
    } else {
      var r = loan(amount, rate, term);
      monthlyEl.textContent = money.format(r.monthly);
      monthlyEl.className = '';
      document.getElementById('paid').textContent = money.format(r.paid);
      document.getElementById('interest').textContent = money.format(r.interest);
    }
    fit(monthlyEl, 32, 18);
  }

  document.getElementById('code').textContent = money.code;
  amountEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  rateEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  customEl.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var digits = digitsOnly(customEl.value);
    state.term = digits ? Number(digits) : state.chip;
    render();
  });
  for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
    chips[i].addEventListener('click', function () {
      customEl.value = '';
      state.term = state.chip = Number(this.getAttribute('data-term'));
      render();
    });
  }
  // The bubble can settle on its final width after the first paint; refit the big number then.
  addEventListener('resize', render);
  // Enter moves from the amount to the rate, then closes the phone keyboard so the result is uncovered.
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    if (e.target === amountEl) rateEl.focus();
    else if (e.target.blur) e.target.blur();
  });
  render();
</script>
`

client.command('loan', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Loan calculator",
    height: 320,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The loan calculator opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
    bypassDownload: false,
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 320 px |
| Size | 10.8 KB |
| Input | Phone keyboard, Tap |
| Download prompt | May appear on some accounts: `bypassDownload: false` keeps the card from reloading and losing its state |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
